# Country scope: Bloc alignment checks.
oe_end_is_bloc_a = {
	var:oe_end_bloc ?= 1
}

oe_end_is_bloc_b = {
	var:oe_end_bloc ?= 2
}

oe_end_is_neutral = {
	var:oe_end_bloc ?= 3
}

oe_end_has_bloc = {
	OR = {
		var:oe_end_bloc ?= 1
		var:oe_end_bloc ?= 2
		var:oe_end_bloc ?= 3
	}
}

oe_end_is_leader_a = {
	has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
	global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this
}

oe_end_is_leader_b = {
	has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
	global_var:oe_end_leader_b ?= this
}

oe_end_is_bloc_leader = {
	OR = {
		oe_end_is_leader_a = yes
		oe_end_is_leader_b = yes
	}
}

# Location scope: Safe owner-guarded checks for the 18 fixed theater anchors.
oe_end_loc_bloc_a = {

	owner = { oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes }
}

oe_end_loc_neutral = {
	has_owner = yes
	owner = { oe_end_is_neutral = yes }
}

# Country scope: Holds >= 2 vanilla hegemons (uses exact 1.4.9 `hegemony:<id>` prefix!).
oe_end_is_multi_hegemon = {
	is_hegemon = yes
	calc_true_if = {
		amount >= 2
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon
		is_hegemon_type = hegemony:diplomatic_hegemon
	}
}

# Any scope: Safe read-only consumption of W2 Slot 85 `global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 65`.
oe_end_heg2_tension_ready = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension }
		global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 65
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}

# Any scope: Safe check whether W2 cached multi-hegemon flag is set.
oe_end_heg2_multi_ready = {
	global_var:oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists ?= 1
}

# Any scope: Unified flashpoint trigger for `oe_sit_eurasian_great_war` (1750-1832 + Dev force).
oe_end_can_trigger_great_war = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_started }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ended }
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_end_test_force ?= 1
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1750
			current_year <= 1832
			OR = {
				oe_end_heg2_tension_ready = yes
				AND = {
					OR = {
						oe_end_heg2_multi_ready = yes
						any_great_power = {
							is_subject = no
							oe_end_is_multi_hegemon = yes
						}
					}
					any_great_power = {
						count >= 2
						is_subject = no
						is_hegemon = no
					}
				}
				AND = {
					current_year >= 1775
					any_great_power = { is_revolutionary = yes }
					any_great_power = {
						is_revolutionary = no
						is_subject = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope: Are Bloc A leader and Bloc B leader currently at war with each other?
oe_end_leaders_at_war = {
	has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
	has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
	country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
	country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
	global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
		is_at_war_with = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
	}
}

# Any scope: World Peace Congress situation action readiness (all var reads safely guarded).
oe_end_congress_action_ready = {
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1825
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_end_exhaustion }
				var:oe_end_exhaustion >= 65
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_end_balance }
				OR = {
					var:oe_end_balance >= 75
					var:oe_end_balance <= 25
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Outcome 1 trigger (Unipolar Imperial Hegemony).
oe_end_outcome_hegemon_ready = {
	NOT = { oe_end_leader_a_is_revolutionary = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win }
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_end_balance
				var:oe_end_balance >= 85
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_end_balance
				var:oe_end_balance >= 70
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b }
					AND = {
						has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
						NOT = { country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Outcome 2 trigger (Vienna-Style Eurasian Concert of Balance).
oe_end_outcome_concert_ready = {
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_end_balance
				var:oe_end_balance <= 15
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_end_balance
				var:oe_end_balance <= 35
				has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
				country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
				global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
					has_variable = oe_ent_index
					var:oe_ent_index >= 85
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_end_balance
				var:oe_end_balance <= 30
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a }
					AND = {
						has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
						NOT = { country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
